definitions.explanation: The part that remains after other parts have been used, removed, or dealt with.

examples.japanese: {残|のこ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦やりましょう→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
{残|のこ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{復習|ふくしゅう}→復習：01718_fukushuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please review in the remaining time.

notes:
{残|のこ}り is the noun form of the verb {残|のこ}る (to remain).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {残|のこ}りの + noun (remaining ~)
- ～の{残|のこ}り (the rest of ~)
- {残|のこ}り⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (leftovers, remains)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to remain (intransitive verb)
- ⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave behind (transitive verb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {残|のこ}り: remainder (noun)
- ⟦あと→あと：09580_ato⟧: remainder, rest (casual)
- ⟦{余|あま}り→余り：17255_amari⟧: surplus, excess
